question:
Requirement: To convert snowflake statement into dbt model

Below is the statement , I am trying figure out how to do Loop in DBT Model , tried sql with cross with dev.abc but count was not matching

DECLARE
    cur_col CURSOR FOR
    SELECT
        col_name
    FROM
        dev.abc;

    my_cur_col VARCHAR(1000);
BEGIN
    FOR RECORD IN cur_col DO my_cur_col:= RECORD.col_name;
INSERT INTO
    dev.results (
        coh_type,
        coh,
        cust,
        so_ls,
        si_ls
    )
SELECT
    :my_cur_col AS coh_type,
    identifier(:my_cur_col) AS coh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS cust,
    SUM(so_ls) AS so_ls,
    SUM(si_ls) AS si_ls
FROM
    (
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(num_empl) AS emp_d,
        LENGTH(ann_rev) AS ann_rev_d
    FROM
        dev.facts
    WHERE rev > 0
    ) AS A
    GROUP BY1,2,3;
    END FOR;
END;
title: DBT: Looping in DBT
answer:
A better approach for this use case would be:

  1. Create a source model that selects the list of columns:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select 
  col_name
from dev.abc
  1. Then in your main model, loop over the columns and UNION ALL the queries:
{% set columns = source('column_source', 'dev') %}

{% for col in columns %}

select
  {{ col }} as coh_type,
  identifier({{ col }}) as coh,
  count(distinct account) as cust,
  sum(so_ls) as so_ls,
  sum(si_ls) as si_ls

from dev.facts
where rev > 0
group by 1,2,3

{% if not loop.last %}
UNION ALL
{% endif %}

{% endfor %}
  1. Materialize the model into a table:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

{% set query %}
...loop query...
{% endset %}

{{ run_query(query) }}
